name: building-blocks-surfaces
title: Surfaces
description: Foundational Tailwind containers for inset, elevated, tinted, dashed, and toolbar-style surfaces.
useWhen: Foundational Tailwind containers for inset, elevated, tinted, dashed, and toolbar-style surfaces.
avoidWhen: Avoid surfaces when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Surfaces uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
